static_traits.name: 李迪安
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系因Persistent self-criticism而受影响；有几位可以交谈的朋友，但尚not yet与他们讨论关于打鼓的负性想法
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病；此前not yet接受心理治疗；过去not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，配合度高，语气中性，能进行自我Reflection但倾向于严苛自我批评

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常对自己的打鼓能力产生负性想法，导致without力感和气馁。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts about my drumming ability have affected my passion for music and my overall mood.
growth_experiences: 几个月前在一场面对大量观众的高压演出中打鼓出现失误；此后每次练习或演出都会反复浮现“我很糟糕”“我会再次失败”等负性自动思维，感到紧张和Anxiety，错误增多、难以享受打鼓；尝试通过加倍练习和向朋友寻求安慰来应对，但积极反馈难以被接纳，负性想法持续加重，并波及到日常心情和与朋友的互动。

special_situations.event: A drumming mistake during a performance in front of a large audience a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在表演中犯错，就说明我not称职/很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍练习并向朋友寻求安慰以证明自己、缓解Anxiety

special_situations.event: Each time I practice or prepare for a performance, recalling that mistake causes stress and tension to rise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must be perfect to be qualified; any error means failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断增加练习时间以避免错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am going to mess up again

special_situations.event: 朋友给予积极反馈或安慰时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的正面评价not可信，只有have not错误才能证明我not差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 一方面寻求外部认可，另一方面negate正向反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是说好话，实际上我很差

special_situations.event: Last week, when rehearsing for a small performance, made frequent mistakes in simple sections
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 过去的失败预示not yet来也会失败；在舞台上我总会出错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在Anxiety中硬撑练习，忽视对表现的客观评估
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果再犯错，后果会很糟糕

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为胜任的鼓手并重新享受音乐
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次失败、被观众或朋友negate，从而失去自信与热爱
defense_goal: 通过自我批评来预防失误与羞耻
通过高强度练习与寻求安慰来缓冲Anxiety、维持掌控感

object_relations.self_representation: not称职、容易失败的演奏者/严苛自我批评者
object_relations.object_representation: not理解自己、只是表面安慰的他人/朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (friends or the counselor) give positive feedback or comfort
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为对方只是出于好意或not真正理解自己（移情：将内在怀疑Projection到他人动机上）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 轻描淡写正面反馈，强调自身not足；语气克制但坚决，重复“我其实很差”的自我评价以维持既有认知。

manifestations: 负性思维使打鼓not再享受，热情下降
对音乐的投入被反复的失败期待所吞not
尚not yet与朋友讨论负性想法
Interpersonal relationships因自我批评而紧张
outcomes: 可用支持not yet被充分利用

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 练习时严苛地盯住错误并进行全局negate
与朋友互动中因自我批评而显得紧张、拘谨

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 认为朋友的安慰只是出于好意、not真实
假设他人not理解自己的真实困难

positive_force: Maintaining stable performance in the work domain, showing resilience and self-efficacy
有几位可信赖的朋友可提供支持
Willing to try behavioral experiments of recording and objective analysis; has motivation to change
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括等认知偏差强烈
严苛自我批评与对错误的高敏感导致Anxiety与紧张
寻求外部认可却negate正向反馈，难以内化积极信息
表演情境下高压唤起增强失败Anticipation

target_behavior.behavior: 打鼓时出现强烈自我批评与Anxiety，紧张并频繁失误
antecedent: 在观众面前的演出或准备演出时
练习时回想过去的失误
收到朋友正面反馈后产生怀疑与negate
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次公开演出失误后形成“我很糟糕/会失败”的核心负性信念与灾难化期待，由此在练习与表演情境中trigger紧张与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻感（通过自我批评与增加练习寻求控制），并通过寻求他人安慰暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 难以享受音乐与打鼓、练习Decreased efficiency且错误增多、Interpersonal tension、整体心情变差
